verdict.rationale: Fireflies offers AskFred, a natural-language meeting assistant, plus an official MCP server that lets AI tools (ChatGPT Deep Research, etc.) query meeting data via natural language commands like comparing objections across calls. However, core product operation (scheduling, admin, most workflows) still requires the GraphQL API/UI rather than NL commands throughout. Missing for 10: evidence of broad NL command coverage across all product functions (not just Q&A/MCP tool calls), independent hands-on verification of AskFred/MCP reliability, and clarity on scope limits of natural-language control.
